system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The blood of the Uzumaki has crystalized and come to bear within you. You can manifest Chains of Binding. A special technique born of special fuinjutsu techniques inherent to your bloodline. These Chains of Binding manifest themselves as chakra-based chains of your description, manifesting themselves from your chakra core, but protruding from your body in a way you describe (from your back, your arms, belly, shoulders, etc.).

As a bonus action you can manifest these chains for 1 minute, by entering your Binding Chain chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

When you enter this stance, you gain the following benefits;

You gain the Seal Break benefit from Uzumaki clan Hijutsu you cast.

When you take the attack action, you can choose to instead make either a Binding Chain or Striking Chain attack. These attacks use you’re your highest jutsu attack bonus.

Binding Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains encircle them. On a hit, you deal half the listed damage and once per turn, make an affected creature make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being Sealed on a failure. Beginning at 7th level, you can increase the number of creatures you can target with this attack to 2. Beginning at 15th level, this increases to 3.

Striking Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains strike out, dealing the listed melee or ranged damage on a hit. You can replace up to two attacks you would make as part of the Attack action with this attack. Beginning at 7th level, attacks against a Grappled or Prone creature is always at advantage. Beginning at 15th level, you can pick one physical damage type, in addition to chakra damage dealing both at the same time.

Melee: 1d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier at 11th level.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th level.
